thread:
Marta: Heads-up: we've seen a pattern where tenant-side proxies replay requests when they get 429. That interacts badly with our fair-scheduler because retries spike their effective throughput and we end up demoting good tenants. Need an approach to penalize retry storms without harming clients that legitimately reattempt.
Theo: Is this mostly exponential-backoff-unaware clients or malicious churn?
Marta: Mix. Some SDKs do naive retry loops and some clients use aggressive optimistic retries.
Ravi: Two levers: (1) server-side de-dup by request-id for short windows, (2) adaptive retry-penalty on client fingerprint when retry-rate crosses threshold.
Sofi: De-dup helps idempotent endpoints but we can't dedupe generative requests. We should focus on rate-limiting semantics.
Theo: Idea: implement a retry-tax token that decays quickly. On first 429, client receives a `retry_tax` header with bucket deduction; subsequent requests within 30s consume from that tax.
Marta: That sounds like a client-visible signal. Some SDKs can use it to back off. But we must ensure it's not used to fingerprint users.
Ravi: For server-side, we can track `retry_burst` as a separate metric and fold it into fairness scoring: tenants with high retry_burst get lower admission priority until their retry error rate falls.
Sofi: Need to be careful: transient network errors can cause bunching. Add a grace: only penalize if retry_burst > 100 reqs/min or if error_type==429 for >2 consecutive windows.
Marta: Also consider headroom reservation: maintain a small reserve for clients with high recent success rates to avoid penalizing proven-good tenants.
Theo: Implementation boundary: add a RetryManager subcomponent in admission that maintains per-tenant EWMA retry_count and issues transient penalties.
Marta: What's the telemetry impact? We'll need new metrics: retry_count, retry_penalty_applied, retry_tax_issued.
Ravi: Security: don't add persistent attributes from retries that could be used to de-anonymize. Keep keys ephemeral and per-tenant.
ops-bot: Note: rollout gated by feature flag `retry-mitigation-v1`. Canary 2% for 4h.
trace-bot: Added tracing span `admission.retry_manager` to request traces when penalty applies.
Sofi: Action items: Theo to draft RetryManager contract; Marta to update fairness scoring doc to include retry_weight; Ravi to propose thresholds and decay windows.
Marta: Let's aim for a short RFC by Thursday.
